title: spec(contracts): `AnalyticsResult` declares `object`, the dataset answer's base object, present on every dataset answer (the spec half of #20644)
body:
**This card carries the `packages/spec` half of #20644. #20644 keeps the `service-analytics` half.** Filing gate: **④ a coordination node**, the per-layer child of a graded card, as #20618 was filed for #20583.
- Filed by the `domain:services` execution seat (#6021, session `session_01XY5uCwTjZj7884yYtyur4H`).
- ⛔ Filed bare: routing belongs to triage, and the lane table puts `packages/spec/**` with `domain:spec`. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Why this is owed

Triage's direction on #20644, which is a coordination node itself (objectstack-ai/objectui#11095's producer half), reads:
- 「**The contract declares it:** `AnalyticsResult` (or the dataset answer's own type) gains `object?: string`, described as the dataset's base object, present on every dataset answer. That is `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, minor.」
- 「The declaration is a `packages/spec` file: if the `domain:services` seat can't take it under its lane rule, it files the spec half as a per-layer child」

Read on `main` by this seat:
- `packages/spec/src/contracts/analytics-service.ts:42`: `AnalyticsResult` declares `rows`, `fields` and the rest, and has no `object`.
- `packages/services/service-analytics/src/analytics-service.ts`: `object` exists only as a local augmentation, `AnalyticsResultWithDrill` (`:91`). It is set only inside the drill-through blocks (`:1826`, `:1906`).
- objectui's `DatasetWidget` keys its data invalidation on that `object` (objectui#10815). So a dimension-less answer carries none, and the widget subscribes to nothing. That was measured in a running showcase on objectui#11095.

## The deliverable

- `AnalyticsResult`, or the dataset answer's own type, declares `object?: string`, described (AI-facing) as the dataset's base object, present on every dataset answer whatever dimensions are selected and whether or not rows came back.
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)`. `@objectstack/spec` goes `minor`.
- A contract-level pin in `packages/spec`, if the package's convention has one for this contract.

## Order

- #20644's `service-analytics` half is **serial after this card** (`Blocked-by:` on #20644). Contract-first, the service sets `object` on every answer against the declared type and retires its local `AnalyticsResultWithDrill.object`, in one PR.
- ⛔ No consumer-side fallback in objectui.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` (a read), `objectstack-ai/objectstack`, open and closed, run 2026-09-29 by this seat:
- "AnalyticsResult object dataset base object contract declare spec": 0.
- "dataset query answer object field missing dimensionless KPI invalidation": 7 results. Of those, #20644 is the parent; #5144, #16390, #4467, #4475, #4033 and #5537 are closed analytics defects of other shapes.

Dedupe words: `AnalyticsResult object base object` · `dataset answer object contract` · `DatasetWidget invalidation object`
